theorem p09 (n : ℕ) : 7 ∣ 8 ^ n - 1 := by
  induction n with
  | zero =>
      norm_num
  | succ n ih =>
      rcases ih with ⟨k, hk⟩
      have hn : 0 < 8 ^ n := by
        positivity
      refine ⟨8 * k + 1, ?_⟩
      rw [pow_succ]
      omega
